acn::acn-abertura.text03: Verify documents, manage processing, monitor collateral, and remain accountable for the contract. A conversation with Accenture about how Catalisa can add to One Financial's operations, delivered white-label, on-premises or as SaaS.

acn::acn-arquitetura.text03: One Financial operates applications across multiple clouds and technology stacks. We propose defining the Catalisa layer's interfaces for the selected journey, alongside the systems and observability already used by operations.

Integration with the selected operation is the focus of the joint work.

acn::acn-contrato.text03: We propose tracking cost per processed contract, time between stages, credit desk interventions, and repeated tasks. One Financial and Catalisa select the journey, baseline, and evaluation criteria.

acn::acn-encaixe.text07: The proposal combines One Financial's operational experience, Accenture's client relationships, and Catalisa's composable capabilities. The joint design assigns owners to the journey, policy, interfaces, and credit desk actions.

The statement describes the proposed division of work for the partnership. Product, architecture, operations, and risk teams help define the owners.
acn::acn-esteira.text03: From document receipt to assessment and authorization, every handoff needs context. For the selected journey, we propose combining field extraction, workflows, and the credit desk with document verification led by One Financial.

Catalisa extracts document fields for workflows, organizes dependencies and response waits, and makes execution and documentation available for credit desk review. The proposal scopes this combination to the selected journey. The diagram follows the document through extracted fields, a task, and team verification to authorization. acn::acn-garantias.text04: Property registry records, documents, asset capacity, and obligations require ongoing monitoring. We propose selecting the collateral scope with One Financial and bringing together evidence for assessment, authorization, and servicing.
acn::acn-garantias.notes: Vivere's mortgage experience and One Financial's credit lines connect with Catalisa's home equity lending secured by real estate, reservations against asset capacity, renewed checks before each disbursement, and obligation monitoring, including loans secured by livestock. The four flagship offerings follow. Regulatory context: Lei nº 14.711 (Brazilian collateral framework law), October 30, 2023: https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2023/lei/l14711.htm. acn::acn-piloto.text08: Proposal, policy, signing, the credit desk, and servicing.
acn::acn-piloto.text14: The outcome per contract and the joint decision.
acn::acn-piloto.notes: The discussion selects one journey of interest. Receivables provide a demonstrable option for exploring terms, signing, the credit desk, and authorization; the four flagship offerings guide the choice of audience and product. Proposed acceptance criteria: verified proposal terms; accessible policy version and decision path; a signed document with a completion certificate; identifiable credit desk authorization within the journey; and accessible transaction history. The owners define the baseline, cost and time data collection, and the method for recording the evaluation. The following proposal and decisioning slides allow two of these criteria to be examined during the presentation.
